semantic_insights: The record carefully distinguishes the pediatric release from wider-project and adult-dataset material, including investigator roles, awards and platform-footer attribution.
The root DOI, citation, version and version-specific page are internally consistent.
Named Canadian REB approval and parental or participant consent align with the documented pediatric human-subject cohort.
The distinction between registered access to derived features and controlled access to original audio is coherent and actionable.
b2aiprep is explicitly tied to producing the distributed features and phenotype files, satisfying the processing-software requirement independently of capture and hosting tools.
